pkgmetadata.longdescription: Epson Scan 2 is Linux software for Epson scanners and multifunction printers. It provides a SANE backend (epsonscan2) usable from any SANE frontend such as simple-scan, and an optional Qt graphical front-end. This package does not install the proprietary non-free plugins.

use.flag: Build the Qt6 graphical front-end (epsonscan2 and detectalert); without it only the SANE driver is installed
Support network (Wi-Fi/Ethernet) scanners through the proprietary media-gfx/epsonscan2-non-free-plugin and net-dns/avahi discovery
